integrity: A self-contained proof establishes a divisor-sum prime-power lemma, the Fermat factorization reduction, parity and binary-weight exclusions, and the unique composite case \(10\). Finite independent integer arithmetic is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The classification is unrestricted in size but assumes \(n>2\) and \(\omega(n)\le2\). It neither proves the global composite-uniqueness conjecture nor resolves any unknown Fermat-prime existence question.
title: Complete two-prime-support classification of simultaneous divisor-sum primality
